repair_feedback: Same-lane repair of dashboard save/apply contract: (1) bridge.saveRuleSet must unwrap the { ruleSet, savedBy } envelope so handleSave receives the ruleSet directly, not the raw platform response; (2) bridge.requestApply must reject on HTTP 404 instead of resolving null, so handleApply surfaces missing-confirmed-plan as an explicit error rather than a misleading generic message; (3) implement a first-save convention: when state.savedRuleSet is null/undefined, omit expectedRevision from the PUT body or send a well-known sentinel that the platform accepts for create-vs-update, and add a faithful unit test proving the first-save path succeeds end-to-end; (4) gate the Apply affordance (button + keyboard shortcut) behind a check that a ConfirmedPlanLookup producer exists, or wire the producer if the integration lane can supply the confirm endpoint, so the apply flow does not silently promise an impossible operation; (5) upgrade all page-level test doubles (applyFlow.test.js, rulesEditorPage.test.js, rulesEditorEntitlement.test.js) from the raw-draft-returning fakes to the faithful shim that enforces envelope unwrapping, expectedRevision validation, and 404-as-error, eliminating the fidelity gap that hid F2 and F3. The accepted base is ec916b75d5600e02d679d264648ac92333d721f1. Per workflow: REJECT means rebuild from accepted state, not blindly patch the rejected candidate.
